# DigiBuilder

> DigiBuilder is a digital marketing and growth agency based in Modasa, Gujarat, India, working with local and international businesses on strategy, branding, social media, websites, advertising and AI workflows.

The site is public and contains service descriptions and client case studies. Project outcomes are reported by DigiBuilder, not guaranteed results. Use the contact page for enquiries; this site does not currently publish a callable AI agent or MCP server.

## About and contact
- [Home](https://digibuilderai.com/): DigiBuilder helps brands grow with digital marketing, branding, social media reels, websites, SEO, advertising and AI automation in Modasa, Gujarat and beyond.
- [About](https://digibuilderai.com/about/): Meet DigiBuilder, a creative digital marketing team based in Modasa, Gujarat. Branding, content, websites, performance marketing and practical AI workflows.
- [Services](https://digibuilderai.com/services/): Explore DigiBuilder services: brand identity, social media marketing, reels and video editing, websites, Google Ads, local SEO and AI automation.
- [Work](https://digibuilderai.com/work/): Explore 22 DigiBuilder case studies covering social media, branding, advertising, e-commerce and AI creative production in India and international markets.
- [Contact](https://digibuilderai.com/contact/): Tell DigiBuilder about your project. Contact our Gujarat-based team for branding, social media, advertising, web design, SEO and AI automation.

## Services
- [Strategy & Growth Consulting](https://digibuilderai.com/service/strategy/): Explore DigiBuilder’s business DNA approach to brand strategy, emotional storytelling, customer insights and practical digital marketing growth plans in Gujarat.
- [Branding & Creative](https://digibuilderai.com/service/brand/): DigiBuilder builds brands from business DNA, with thoughtful positioning, visual identity, meaningful storytelling and consistent creative design in Gujarat.
- [Websites & E-commerce](https://digibuilderai.com/service/web/): DigiBuilder designs fast, mobile-friendly websites and e-commerce experiences built around your brand, customer journey, SEO foundations and business growth.
- [Social Media, Reels & Video](https://digibuilderai.com/service/social/): Build a meaningful social media presence with DigiBuilder through audience-led content strategy, Instagram reels, video shoots, editing and publishing.
- [SEO, Advertising & Performance](https://digibuilderai.com/service/seo/): DigiBuilder connects technical SEO, local search, Google Ads, Meta advertising and useful landing pages to customer intent and practical business goals.
- [AI Automation & Workflows](https://digibuilderai.com/service/ai/): Explore human-supervised AI automation with DigiBuilder: business workflow discovery, focused AI assistants, careful prototypes and practical team handover.
